messages:
maria: FYI noticing a new spike in cross-region retries after yesterday's LB heuristic change. TL;DR: several regions hit 5xx+retries and TLS handshakes timed out, causing route failover loops.

samir: saw it too — clouds metrics show a retry burst 03:12-03:23 UTC, root cause unclear. attaching logs snippet:

samir: ```
ALB: tls_handshake_timeout conn_id=0x7f3 err=TIMEOUT SNI=prod.app.redwood
DNS: retry loop detected for host api.prod.redwood -> zmq...
``` 

jess: quick question — is this the same pattern as last-quarter's cross-region failover? looks similar but SNI mismatch not obvious.

kai: not identical. last time was conntrack saturation; this one shows LB returning 502 + TCP reset during TLS negotiation. could be upstream cert fetch or a routing table flurry.

dylan: I ran a trace — requests were bounced between us-east and eu-west every ~200ms for a client-IP range. probably health-check oscillation + retry policy.

maria: proposed actions:
1) short-term: pin retry-policy to single attempt for affected routes (owner: samir) - ETA 2h
2) triage: collect packet captures and TLS logs (owner: kai) - ETA EOD
3) remediation: add sticky routing for at-risk prefixes to break oscillation (owner: jess) - ETA 72h
4) detection: add recurring alert for >100 cross-region retries/5m (owner: dylan) - ETA 24h

samir: taking action 1. will update firewall rule and rollout canary to 5% then 100%.

kai: starting pcap now. will upload to /incidents/1847654321/pcap.tar.gz and add notes.

jess: will draft sticky routing change and run in staging. need approval from eng-platform for schema change.

dylan: alert added to playbook dashboard (alert id: RBW-CR-027). will add runbook steps.

ops-bot: Incident bot: new incident created INC-2026-0482 linked to thread 1847654321.

sre-oncall: pinging eng-sre for any known LB kernel updates applied last night.

maria: follow-ups: samir to confirm canary results, kai to upload artifacts, jess to open PR with routing config, dylan to verify alert triggers. cadence: daily check-in at 16:00 UTC until resolved. If we see recurrence after remediation, escalate to postmortem.

samir: canary rolled to 5% now. early telemetry looks good — retries down 60% on sample traffic.

kai: uploaded pcaps and extracted TLS debug: https://internal/redwood/incidents/1847654321/tls-debug.txt

jess: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/673. linking canary config.

dylan: added automated regression test to detect oscillation: infra/e2e/retry-loop-test. Will run nightly.

maria: thanks all. I'll close the loop in the postmortem doc once owners confirm stable for 48h. :thumbsup:

samir: noted. will post a short summary when canary hits 100%.
